method.passing: Five simultaneous outlets, one-factor matched conditions and combined blocked_build_up fixture; three paired seeds (one in smoke). Canonical ranked options are independently counterfactually selected for physical probes; firstRanked is an observation, not proof of execution. Predictor models the intended receiver reaching the error envelope: intendedContactCompleted is its comparable numerator; completed is canonical first actual teammate contact (which can differ). Neither promises control or later retention. Future progression is predicted completion times intended signed depth gain, not a full continuation forecast. No prediction is pooled with censored outcomes.
method.marking: Eight-second isolated motion harness with scripted threat routes and an advancing fullback in the DM-cover scenario. At=0 is static initial geometry, subsequent samples/final are dynamic. Baseline uses current canonical targets; experimental greedily assigns local zone/man responsibility with line and zone costs/hysteresis. Shared capability/facing/fitness, fixture acceleration and separation produce meaningful motion; this is not the canonical full-match movement integrator. Final geometries launch genuine canonical eight-second ball/contact probes, which immediately resume production tactics. No experimental marking installed in production.
method.limits: Small synthetic paired sample, not population calibration. Accessible lanes, missedThreats (>5m), central gap, space behind average line and excess movement are geometric proxies. Interceptions/fouls are actual canonical post-geometry probe counts, not motion-harness events; zero does not establish safety. Null means unavailable/censored. No historical playtest checkpoint reconstructed.
